title: The Grateful Dead Live at Betty Nelson's Organic Raspberry Farm on 1968-09-02
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Tascam SS-R05 -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2 -> FLAC
source: SBD -> Master Reel (1/2-inch 4-track reels recorded on Ampex 440) -> Dat (Tascam DA30/44.1k)

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a primal 9/2/68 show highlighted by a monster Dark Star and an epic Eleven second‑theme jam.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as outstanding and fantastic, clearly a high‑quality soundboard source that lets the band’s raw 1968 energy shine through. Reviewers rave about the powerful set – especially the soaring Dark Star, the lengthy Eleven “second theme” jam, and the fiery interplay of Jerry, Bob and Pigpen – while noting only minor vocal balance quirks. Overall the performance is described as the group firing on all six cylinders, making this a must‑listen snapshot of late‑summer ’68.

ai_rating.rationale: The vast majority of reviews are 5‑star and highlight both an exceptional musical performance and superb soundboard audio, with only two low‑rated, off‑topic comments that do not detract from the overall consensus.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple reviewers call the audio outstanding, crisp and fantastic; no significant dropouts or balance issues reported aside from slightly low vocals.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A high‑octane, primal set that builds momentum throughout; the band is described as firing on all six cylinders with seamless transitions and intense improvisation.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for opening lick in The Eleven jam and overall powerful guitar work.
band_member_comments.Bob: Highlighted for “crazy stuff” – strong rhythm guitar and vocals, especially alongside Pigpen.
band_member_comments.Drums: Pigpen’s drumming and vocal contributions are singled out as energetic and impressive.
